title: Bridging Foundational and Agentic Capabilities of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents, yet it remains unclear how their foundational capabilities translate into agentic capabilities. End-to-end scores leave unresolved whether low benchmark capability or weak deployment drives a failure, limiting actionable diagnosis. We bridge foundational and agentic capabilities through an operation-level measurement framework. We represent each model with a foundational profile derived from capability benchmarks and an operation profile derived from interaction trajectories, and define capability realization gaps as deviations of observed operation performance from predictions based on foundational capabilities. Experiments on fifteen model services in $\tau^2$-Bench show that foundational profiles only partially predict agentic operations. Models with comparable profiles can differ substantially in execution, and these gaps remain consistent across task subsets. Operatio

translated_title: 桥接大语言模型的基础能力与智能体能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为智能体，但其基础能力如何转化为智能体能力仍不清楚。端到端的评分无法判断失败究竟是由于基准能力低下还是部署环节薄弱所致，这限制了可操作的诊断。我们通过一个操作层面的测量框架来桥接基础能力与智能体能力。我们使用从能力基准得出的基础画像（foundational profile）和从交互轨迹得出的操作画像（operation profile）来刻画每个模型，并将“能力实现差距”定义为观测到的操作性能与基于基础能力预测值之间的偏差。在 τ²-Bench 上对十五个模型服务的实验表明，基础画像只能部分预测智能体操作表现。画像相近的模型在执行层面可能存在显著差异，且这些差距在不同任务子集之间保持一致。操作……
tldr: 该论文提出一个操作层面的测量框架，通过定义“能力实现差距”来量化大语言模型基础能力向智能体能力的转化程度，发现基础能力基准只能部分预测智能体操作表现，画像相似的模型在实际执行中差异显著。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an operation-level measurement framework that defines "capability realization gaps" to quantify how LLMs' foundational capabilities translate into agentic capabilities, finding that foundational profiles only partially predict agentic operation performance, with similar models differing substantially in execution.
